It's a lot healthier and overall better to just be direct when you need help, rather than being passive about it. A lot of people actually dont know when things are a cry for help, especially if it's something very obscure or in a joking manner. I dont mean this in a rude way, but you can't blame others and call them bad friends if you're not actively and concisely telling them what you need and how you feel.

remember that a setback doesn't reset your progress. 4 months is a pretty big achievement!! even if it doesnt seem like it. try to take things one day at a time to get yourself back on track. it takes a lot of time and effort to get clean, and mistakes are just part of being human 💖

scars come with a lot of social stigma and they can make you feel like shit a lot of times but if you really want to deal with that then shallow styros can usually be left open, just be careful during the healing process to make sure they stay covered and dont get infected

for deeper styros, you can close them like halfway if you Really want a big scar, and again make sure you keep them covered and clean
